title: In Rare Letter, the Rebbe Reveals What He Did Before Asking Anything
blurb: In a recently released letter, the Rebbe reveals two rare details about his personal conduct, describing how he responded when people turned to him for help and how he decided when to ask others for assistance.

title: With ‘Farshtey’ You Can Understand the Rebbe’s Yiddish
blurb: Farshtey, a free app with no ads, teaches you to read a sicha in the original, one passage at a time. A short game quizzes you on what each word means and comprehension of the passage.

title: New Sefer Explores the Alter Rebbe on Hilchos Ribis
blurb: The fifth volume in the acclaimed Yesodei HaShulchan U’Zikukei Orosov series, authored by Rabbi Shmuel Zajac , a Magid Shiur at Yeshivas Tomchei Temimim Morristown, explores the intricate halachos of ribis and iska in the Shulchan Aruch of the Alter Rebbe, offering an invaluable resource for those learning Perek Eizehu Neshech and Hilchos Ribis.
